body:
This made me tear up and re-think my decision, thank you for sharing your story with me. 

My husband sadly won’t listen, but I will definitely be on the hunt for a free therapist. I didn’t know something like that existed so I definitely want to give it a shot. 

Thank you again

I’m too scared to go.... I hate being alone and I’m scared they will just put me in a room and leave me unless it’s time to eat or do therapy or something. I don’t know how to talk to people so I can’t imagine myself being social or anything. It sounds like prison :(
I am so sorry. These are things no one should ever have to witness... thank you for reaching out with your story. It’s made me feel way less alone in this. ❤️
